summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB bundle on npm install
details: Package presents itself as a static Markdown/HTML viewer but its declared `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) is an obfuscated downloader that fetches the Bun runtime binary from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases (bun-v1.3.13) to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` in the package. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle carrying obfuscator.io-style transforms (large hex-literal string array, array-rotation function, `with`-statement parser-blockers, `_0x`-renamed identifiers) whose contents are unrelated to a Markdown viewer and cannot be inspected without executing under Bun. `setup.mjs` itself is likewise obfuscated with `_0x`-style identifiers and per-call thunked wrappers on top of an otherwise simple download-and-exec flow. The Bun runtime is being used as an alternate runtime to execute an opaque bundle at `npm install` time, bypassing Node-based static review. The package's declared purpose does not require a second language runtime or a compiled bundle.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
